signals.title: Apple close to using CXMT DRAM beyond SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron - Sammy Fans
signals.summary: Sammy Fans reports Apple is close to using CXMT DRAM alongside SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron.
signals.analysis: The report is relevant for data centre storage: it could alter prices, available capacities or procurement strategy for enterprise SSDs.

signals.title: Samsung HBM4 yield surges to 80%, ahead of year-end target: report (SSNLF:OTCMKTS)
signals.summary: Seeking Alpha reports Samsung HBM4 yield surges to 80%, ahead of its year‑end target (SSNLF:OTCMKTS).
signals.analysis: Higher HBM yields can accelerate the ramp of new AI accelerators and free up more HBM capacity in the medium term. Key is whether the yield improvement is observable in production volumes and delivered modules.
